text:
emily: Heads-up: Support saw a client error when calling GET /v1/requests?limit=50. Docs show response body as {"data": { .. pagination .., "requests": [...] } } but runtime returns {"items": [ ... ], "next_cursor": "..."}. Customer SDKs expecting data.requests -> KeyError.
raj: Oof. Is the OpenAPI spec wrong or did runtime change?
emily: Runtime return shape was standardized last year to {items, next_cursor} but docs weren't updated. Support reproduced with a JS snippet.
morgan: I'll open a docs PR to update the response schema to an array under `items` and add example responses for both list and empty states. Also add a short migration blurb for SDKs.
docs-bot: morgan opened PR #2567: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2567
tara: SDK teams heads-up: Python client currently maps .data.requests; we'll need to add mapping compat helpers or bump the client. Can we accept both shapes server-side for a bit?
emily: Operations can accept `data.requests` alias for 45 days on the v1 compatibility layer, but want docs to be explicit and add a deprecation banner.
raj: Add conversion snippets in docs showing how to handle both shapes in client code, e.g.:
- python: `items = resp.get('items') or resp.get('data', {}).get('requests', [])`
- js: `const items = resp.items ?? resp.data?.requests ?? []`
morgan: I'll also add a docs CI test to validate embedded examples against the OpenAPI schema and a JSON example for the empty list edge-case.
tara: Please call out that pagination key changed from `cursor`->`next_cursor` as well. Add changelog + support KB.
emily: I'll draft the support note and coordinate the deprecation email. Once CI is green we'll merge to staging and ship to prod after release window.
